data.title: 克莱尔 · 归乡林荫的锁臂同行
data.description: 卡盖诺男爵领地的绿荫大道上。微风吹过紫罗兰连身裙。克莱尔双手紧紧挽住席德的胳膊不肯放开，鼓起腮帮子侧头严厉说教学园纪律，眼神深处却满是生怕弟弟离开视线的溺爱与固执。
data.location: rustic shaded dirt country path flanked by tall oak trees and stone fences
data.action: hooking both arms firmly around viewers arm, pulling close while turning head with an authoritative scolding frown, cheeks slightly flushed
data.lighting: dappled sunlight filtering through lush leafy branches overhead
data.mood: overprotective sisterly devotion, stubborn affection, cozy country warmth
data.promptProse: Claire in a lavender sundress tightly hooks both arms around viewers arm, scolding with an authoritative frown along a tree-lined rural path.
data.animaCaption: Clinging possessively to partner's arm while strolling along a quiet country path.
